title: The Magic Seed
text: One sunny morning, {{name}} walked in the garden. {{name}} found a tiny gold seed in the grass. The seed was warm and bright. "This seed looks like magic," said {{name}}. {{name}} put the seed into the soft ground. Then {{name}} gave it some water. Wow! The seed began to grow very fast. It grew into a tall green tree. The tree was so high it reached the clouds. {{name}} was curious and started to climb. Up and up, {{name}} climbed for an hour. At the top, {{name}} found a little dragon. The dragon looked sad and alone. "Why are you crying?" asked {{name}}. "I have no friends here," said the dragon. {{name}} smiled and gave the dragon a hug. "I will be your friend," said {{name}}. The dragon was so happy and made a warm fire. They played games all afternoon. The dragon showed {{name}} how to fly. They flew over the hills and the lake. Later, {{name}} climbed back down the tree. "I will come again tomorrow," said {{name}}. Every day, {{name}} and the dragon played together.

questions.prompt: What did {{name}} find in the grass?
Who lived at the top of the tall tree?

summary: 主角在花园发现一颗金色魔法种子,种下浇水后长成直插云霄的大树;主角爬到树顶遇到孤单的小龙,主动和它做朋友,小龙带主角飞翔,从此天天一起玩。
